title: Add one foreground-focused debugger Input spike
approved_decision: For exactly one existing human-selected pending post, foreground the dedicated worker tab and focus its Chrome window before the already-approved Activity-control CDP press/release pair.
unchanged_boundaries: one post, one worker tab, one press/release pair, immediate detach
no CDP Network, Storage, Cookies, DOMSnapshot, screenshots, or arbitrary Runtime evaluation
no source text, metrics, credentials, cookie, storage, or DOM persistence
no batch integration, retry, or automatic alternative interaction method
